{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN (due to non-numeric values)
df = df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check if 'converted' is binary (0 or 1)
if not df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all():
    print('Converted column contains values other than 0 or 1')

# Check if any converted order has status != 'completed'
non_completed_converted = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] != 'completed')]
print(f'Number of converted orders with non-completed status: {len(non_completed_converted)}')

# Recalculate conversion rate after cleaning
conversion_rate_by_segment_clean = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Output the cleaned conversion rates
conversion_rate_by_segment_clean"}
